title: Phase 4R structural search: which configuration can pose an allocation problem at all?

split.note: calibration items only; the gate re-tests on held-out episodes

metric: S1 = P(X>K) and E[X]/K where X is useful opportunities and K affordable upgrades; S2 = mean actual DEEP cost / cap(DEEP); ceiling = U(oracle) - U(greedy) through the canonical executor
notes: Configuration selected by S1 and S2, both frozen before this ran. The ceiling is reported for every cell, never used to select.
